objective: init creates or updates .gitignore with one delimited block for the local index and cache, pem and key files, and env files, while .env.example and public keys under .retornatus/keys stay committable. A second init does not duplicate that block or remove existing lines. receipt keygen keeps the private key outside the repository, and init plus keygen print a warning when git tracks a pem or key file. The changelog, CLI reference, and vulnerability policy describe that behavior.
success_conditions: pytest exits 0 for fresh, repeated, and preserved gitignore lines
git check-ignore exits 1 for a pub file and exits 0 for pem
CHANGELOG Unreleased and CLI.md contain the init ignore rules
The vulnerability policy file contains the init ignore rules
keygen prints a warning when git tracks a pem file

tasks.description: Append an idempotent gitignore block from init, warn on tracked private keys, and document it
